title: A Patient Navigation Trial for Housing and Health (PATHH)
official: A Patient Navigation Trial for Housing and Health (PATHH): A Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: This study will describe and evaluate the experiences and outcomes of women who have survived violence and also have medical needs. The intervention being tested is a service called 'PATHH', a patient navigation service that extends after a stay in an emergency shelter. Some people who join the study will work with the PATHH patient navigator, and some will receive standard care at the community shelter. Participants who are assigned the PATHH navigator will receive additional support and help linking with services in the community during and after their emergency shelter stay. By doing this study, how patient navigation services affect the health and housing stability among women who have survived violence will be better understood.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. self-identify as a woman;
2. are age 18 or older
3. report a history of physical or sexual violence in the last year using the Revised Conflict Tactics Scale
4. report a qualifying health condition requiring ongoing engagement in healthcare and commonly occurring in this population, including substance use disorder, depression, and/or HIV.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. current stable housing
2. inability or unwillingness to provide informed consent in English.
